g.text: Final-network ROC: legacy SJARACNe versus SJARACNe2
Final MI scores; non-retained labelled pairs share score 0. Legends report full-range AUROC.
Dots: all retained labelled edges. Dotted tails: the omitted-pair score tie. Early-ROC panels use different recall scales.
